PANDA BOX AND LINES LICENSED - MT4 (v1.41)

1. In MT4, open File > Open Data Folder.
2. Copy MQL4/Indicators/Panda Box and Lines Licensed.ex4 into MQL4/Indicators.
3. Copy MQL4/Experts/Panda Box and Lines License Feed.ex4 into MQL4/Experts.
4. In Tools > Options > Expert Advisors, enable WebRequest for listed URL and add:
   https://pandaengine.app
5. Refresh Navigator. Attach Panda Box and Lines License Feed to one chart. It does
   not open or manage trades. Attach Panda Box and Lines Licensed to the chart(s)
   where you want the scoring panel, boxes, and levels.
6. In Panda Engine License Admin, create a Panda Box and Lines Licensed for MT4 license using
   the MT4 trading account number, then press Approve. No token is needed.

The EA checks immediately and every 5 minutes. The indicator updates every 5
seconds. If the account is not approved or the check is unavailable/stale, the
indicator hides its scores and chart drawings and shows a license status.

The indicator Inputs tab has one setting: PanelPosition (upper left or upper
right). The panel starts in the upper right. Box drawing settings are internal.
The three boxes are yellow and all panel text is blue. The narrow top strip
can still be dragged to move the panel temporarily.

Scores and ADV forecast are calculated locally from MT4 broker history across
21 Panda pairs. H1 history for those pairs must be loaded. The license EA only
checks account approval and requires an internet connection to Panda Engine.
